# History Log 108: Depth-3D Autogenerated Cache Location and Sample Story Assets Reorganization

- **Date**: 2026-10-01
- **Task**: Route all generated subject cutouts and depth estimation maps to `autogenerated/depth-3d` in `depth3d/index.ts` and reorganize `sample-story` media files into `sample-story/assets/`.
- **Status**: Completed

## 1. Problem
1. When generating subject cutout masks (`*_subject_*.png`, `*.json`) and depth estimation maps (`*_depth_*.png`) from `packages/effect-engines/src/depth3d/index.ts`, generated files were previously saved directly into the image's source folder (cluttering the story directory).
2. Media files (`scene1.jpg`, `scene2.jpg`, `b-roll-nature.mp4`, `bgm.mp3`, `voiceover1.mp3`, `voiceover2.mp3`, etc.) were placed at the root level of `sample-story/` alongside configuration and temporary files.

## 2. Plan & Architecture
1. **Depth-3D Cache Routing (`depth3d/index.ts`)**:
   - Added `getStoryRootAndCacheDir(resolvedImagePath)` to dynamically locate the story root containing `story-config.json` and resolve `autogenerated/depth-3d/`.
   - Updated subject cutout resolution and saving: checks `depthConfig.subjectImage`, then strategy+checksum, checksum, and base names in `autogenerated/depth-3d/` before checking legacy locations. Automatically persists new segmentations into `autogenerated/depth-3d/`.
   - Updated depth map resolution and saving: checks explicit path, strategy+checksum, checksum, and base names in `autogenerated/depth-3d/`. Automatically persists new depth estimation maps into `autogenerated/depth-3d/`.
2. **Sample-Story Directory Reorganization**:
   - Created `sample-story/assets/` and moved all source media files (`scene1.jpg`, `scene2.jpg`, `b-roll-nature.mp4`, `bgm.mp3`, `voiceover1.mp3`, `voiceover2.mp3`, `voiceover1.txt`, `voiceover2.txt`) into `sample-story/assets/`.
   - Created `sample-story/autogenerated/depth-3d/` and moved all generated subject cutout images, test pop-out frames, and depth maps into `sample-story/autogenerated/depth-3d/`.
   - Updated `sample-story/story-config.json` to explicitly reference `assets/` paths.
   - Updated `StoryRenderer.ts` BGM resolution to gracefully handle `assets/` subdirectories.
   - Updated `autogenerated-tests/depth_strategies_benchmark.test.ts` to locate `sample-story/assets/scene1.jpg` and write benchmarks to `sample-story/autogenerated/depth-3d/`.

## 3. Changes
- `packages/effect-engines/src/depth3d/index.ts`: Added `getStoryRootAndCacheDir` and routed all subject cutouts and depth map saves and lookups to `autogenerated/depth-3d/`.
- `apps/cli/src/pipelines/04-generative-story/StoryRenderer.ts`: Enhanced BGM path resolution with `assets/` fallback search.
- `sample-story/story-config.json`: Updated `image`, `audio`, `video`, and `bgm` paths to point to `assets/`.
- `sample-story/assets/`: Consolidated source media assets.
- `sample-story/autogenerated/depth-3d/`: Centralized all autogenerated 3D depth assets.
- `autogenerated-tests/depth_strategies_benchmark.test.ts`: Updated sample image and output benchmark directory paths.

## 4. Verification
- `bun test autogenerated-tests/stress_render.test.ts`: 2/2 iterations passed (81.4s), verifying 12-scene 1080p video generation with assets loaded from `assets/` and depth3d cache loaded from `autogenerated/depth-3d/`.
- `bun test autogenerated-tests/depth_strategies_benchmark.test.ts`: 5/5 passed.
- `bun run cli.ts ./sample-story`: Completed full video render in 24.2s.
- `bun run auto-config.ts ./sample-story --yes`: Verified automated asset discovery and metadata sync.

## 5. Walkthrough
- View directory structure:
  - `sample-story/assets/` (source media files)
  - `sample-story/autogenerated/depth-3d/` (cached segment masks & depth maps)
  - `sample-story/autogenerated/voiceovers/` (TTS audio files)
  - `sample-story/output/` (rendered mp4 files)
  - `sample-story/story-config.json` (canonical configuration)
